PRENATAL CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Centre

PATIENT: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
HOSPITAL NUMBER: [redacted ID]
REFERRING CLINICIAN: Dr [redacted name]
DATE OF COLLECTION: [redacted date]
DATE OF REPORT: [redacted date]

CLINICAL DETAILS
Prenatal testing requested on amniotic fluid sample
Maternal age: 41 years
Gestation: 17 weeks by ultrasound dating
Indication: Advanced maternal age

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)
Rapid aneuploidy screening for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21

METHODOLOGY
DNA extracted from uncultured amniocytes
Multiplex QF-PCR analysis using fluorescently labelled primers for STR markers on chromosomes 13, 18, and 21
Products analysed by capillary electrophoresis
Minimum of 4 informative markers assessed per chromosome

RESULTS

Chromosome 13: Normal diallelic pattern
Informative markers: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
Conclusion: Two copies of chromosome 13 detected

Chromosome 18: Normal diallelic pattern  
Informative markers: D18S391, D18S390, D18S535, D18S386
Conclusion: Two copies of chromosome 18 detected

Chromosome 21: Normal diallelic pattern
Informative markers: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1446
Conclusion: Two copies of chromosome 21 detected

SUMMARY
Normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21
No evidence of trisomy 13, 18, or 21 detected

LIMITATIONS
This test screens only for trisomies of chromosomes 13, 18, and 21
Other chromosomal abnormalities, mosaicism <20%, and structural rearrangements are not excluded

FOLLOW-UP
Full karyotype analysis from cultured amniocytes is in progress and will be reported separately

Authorised by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Date: [redacted date]
